content: {"reasoning":"Authorization was required, and the payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review; two medical-necessity appeals have already failed to resolve the denial. CO-197 assigns the denial to contractual responsibility, so the deductible and coinsurance alone do not establish a billable patient balance, and there is no secondary payer. With no identified correction or remaining productive payer route, write off the uncollectible balance; similar patient-billing attempts yielded no payments.","action":"write_off"}
